about_zh: 代理、隧道、DNS、下载——让流量按你的意思走。

repos.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库自动维护并更新最新的公共BitTorrent tracker列表，提供多协议（UDP/HTTP/HTTPS等）及IP直连版本，旨在提升BT客户端的节点发现效率与下载速度，适用于P2P分享与网络优化。
repos.summary_en: An automatically updated, comprehensive list of public BitTorrent trackers, offering multi-protocol and IP-based formats to optimize peer discovery, bypass DNS issues, and maximize download performance for BitTorrent clients.

repos.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！
repos.summary_zh: 每日更新的全网热门BT Tracker集合，专为加速BitTorrent等P2P客户端下载而生。提供多格式列表与Aria2配置，有效解决BT下载连接慢、资源少的核心痛点。
repos.summary_en: Daily-updated collection of popular BitTorrent Trackers, designed to significantly boost P2P download speeds in clients like qBittorrent and Aria2. Provides multi-format lists with fast CDN mirrors for easy setup and maximum peer connectivity.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader是抖音/TikTok下载与数据采集工具，支持高清视频、图集、直播流下载，具备批量采集、多账号管理、数据持久化及Web UI交互。基于Python开发，支持Docker部署，提供代理、多线程、断点续传等功能，适用于内容存档与数据分析。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a TikTok/Douyin downloading and data collection tool, supporting HD videos, image albums, and live stream capture. It features batch collection, multi-account management, data persistence, and Web UI interaction. Built with Python and Docker, it offers proxy support, multi-threading, and resumable downloads for content archiving and data analysis.

repos.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages，提供Vless和Trojan代理脚本，支持多种TLS模式，无需自定义域名和频繁更新节点，简化科学上网配置。适用于个人代理服务器搭建，具有懒人部署、多客户端订阅格式等亮点。
repos.summary_en: This project provides Vless and Trojan proxy scripts based on Cloudflare Workers/Pages, supporting multiple TLS modes. It simplifies proxy setup without custom domains or frequent node updates, ideal for personal proxy servers, featuring easy deployment and multiple client subscription formats.

repos.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy
repos.summary_zh: whistle 是一款基于 Node.js 的跨平台网络抓包与调试代理工具，支持 HTTP、HTTPS、HTTP/2、WebSocket 等协议的抓取与修改。它通过声明式规则引擎和可视化界面，助力开发者高效进行接口联调、Mock 数据与性能排障。
repos.summary_en: Whistle is a cross-platform, Node.js-based network debugging proxy tool designed for capturing and modifying HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, and WebSocket protocols. It features a powerful rule engine, web-based UI, and extensible plugins, enabling developers to efficiently inspect and troubleshoot network requests.

repos.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems
repos.summary_zh: ProxyPin是一款基于Flutter的跨平台开源HTTP(S)抓包工具，支持全平台系统。它集扫码连接、域名过滤、JS脚本、请求重写与解密功能于一体，界面美观，是开发者抓取、调试和修改网络流量的得力助手。
repos.summary_en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free, and cross-platform HTTP(S) traffic capture and debugging tool built with Flutter, supporting Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, and Linux. It offers features like mobile scan-to-connect, domain filtering, JavaScript scripting, request rewriting, and AES decryption. With a beautiful UI, it helps developers easily intercept, inspect, rewrite, and map network requests for efficient app debugging.

repos.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.
repos.summary_zh: 该面板提供VLESS、Trojan和Warp配置的Worker订阅，内置私有DoH服务器及链式代理，支持全DNS、清洁IP、Fragment、Warp Pro和路由设置，适用于Amnezia、Wireguard、Sing-box、Clash/Mihomo和Xray核心的跨平台客户端，确保网络自由与安全。
repos.summary_en: BPB Worker Panel is a GUI panel that provides subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan, and Warp configurations, along with a private DoH server and chain proxies. It offers comprehensive settings for DNS, clean IP, Fragment, Warp Pro, and routing, ensuring connectivity even when domains or services are blocked. Designed for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo, and Xray cores, it supports bypassing censorship and sanctions, providing a secure and private proxy solution for users worldwide. With intuitive navigation and full customizability, it is an ideal tool for managing network privacy.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP是一个开源、支持Docker一键自部署的全能IP工具箱，集成多源IP查询、WebRTC与DNS泄露检测、浏览器指纹分析、全球网速与延迟测试、MTR路由追踪及Whois查询。结合PWA技术支持，旨在为用户提供一站式网络隐私保护、连接质量诊断与基础设施深度探测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is an open-source, all-in-one IP toolbox designed for comprehensive network diagnostics and privacy protection. Self-hostable via a single Docker command and supported as a PWA, it integrates multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC & DNS leak detection, browser fingerprinting, global speed and latency tests, MTR, and Whois queries. It provides users with an all-in-one solution for security assessment and infrastructure exploration.

repos.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.
repos.summary_zh: FileCentipede是一款跨平台多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP、FTP、SSH、BT及WebDAV，并集成浏览器插件，可智能提取网页音视频，实现一站式高效上传、下载与文件管理。
repos.summary_en: FileCentipede is a powerful, cross-platform, multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, SSH, WebDAV, and BitTorrent. With browser integration, it intelligently extracts online audio and video, providing a one-stop solution for high-speed uploads, downloads, and comprehensive file management.

repos.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.
repos.summary_zh: MediaGo是一款跨平台视频下载工具，内置流量嗅探技术，可自动识别并抓取m3u8/HLS流，支持Bilibili、YouTube等千余站点。提供桌面应用、Docker部署及浏览器扩展，集成AI助手技能，通过HTTP API实现自动化下载与格式转换，无需复杂配置，一键获取高清视频。
repos.summary_en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in sniffing to automatically detect and grab m3u8/HLS streams, supporting Bilibili, YouTube, and over a thousand sites. It offers desktop app, Docker deployment, and browser extension, with AI assistant integration and HTTP API for automated downloading and format conversion, no complex setup required.

repos.description: 🗽Бесплатные и проверенные VPN/Tor конфигурации, работающие в РФ ⚪ Белые списки / обход белых списков ⚪ Free and checked VPN/Tor configurations that work in Russia ⚪ Whitelists bypass
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库收集并自动测试适用于俄罗斯的免费VPN配置，支持VLESS、Trojan等多种协议，兼容多个主流客户端。通过每2-4小时的自动测试和更新，确保配置的有效性和高性能，帮助用户绕过俄罗斯的网络封锁，保持在线访问。
repos.summary_en: This repository collects and automatically tests free VPN configurations for Russia, supporting multiple protocols like VLESS, Trojan, and compatible with various clients. With automated testing and updates every 2-4 hours, it ensures configuration effectiveness and performance, helping users bypass network censorship in Russia and maintain online access.

repos.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目定时自动合并、去重并清洗多源广告过滤规则，通过DNS解析剔除失效域名，生成适用于AdGuard、dnsmasq等平台的轻量/完整版拦截列表，提升广告拦截效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: This project automatically merges and cleans multi-source ad-blocking rules on a regular basis, filtering out dead domains via DNS resolution. It generates optimized blocklists for platforms like AdGuard and dnsmasq, ensuring efficient and accurate ad-blocking.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供全球免费代理IP列表，包含HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4和SOCKS5协议，每5分钟更新一次。支持JSON、TXT、CSV格式下载，并提供NPM模块和API接口，适用于爬虫、匿名访问和网络测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Provides a highly reliable, frequently updated list of free HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies from over 140 countries. Updated every 5 minutes, it offers data in JSON, TXT, and CSV formats, along with an NPM module and rotating proxy API for seamless integration into scraping and automation workflows.

repos.description: Get PROXY List  that gets updated everyday
repos.summary_zh: 该GitHub仓库TheSpeedX/PROXY-List提供每日更新的免费公共代理列表，涵盖SOCKS5、SOCKS4和HTTP协议，总代理数超过7200个。核心价值在于自动化收集和更新，确保列表时效性，适用于教育研究、网络测试等场景。技术亮点包括多种协议支持和直接下载链接，强调合法使用，避免非法活动。
repos.summary_en: TheSpeedX/PROXY-List is a GitHub repository that offers a daily updated collection of free public proxies, including SOCKS5, SOCKS4, and HTTP protocols, with over 7200 entries. It provides value through automated updates for freshness, catering to educational purposes and network testing. Key technical features are protocol diversity and easy download access, while emphasizing legal and ethical usage.

repos.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。
repos.summary_zh: FluxDown 是一款基于 Rust 的高性能多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent 及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，具备智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。其跨平台设计覆盖桌面、移动和 Web，提供自动化任务管理与 AI 智能体接口，永久免费且零广告。
repos.summary_en: FluxDown is a Rust-powered, multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and HLS/DASH streaming. It features intelligent multi-threaded acceleration, browser integration, and cross-platform support for desktop, mobile, and web. With automation and AI agent capabilities, it's free and ad-free.

repos.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出
repos.summary_zh: x-ui-yg 是一款精简修改版脚本，专注于简化代理服务器搭建。它支持 Hysteria2、Xhttp 等先进协议和多种加密方式，集成 Argo 隧道和 Psiphon VPN 分流，可生成多种订阅配置。适用于个人或企业快速部署高性能代理服务，技术亮点在于本地化节点生成和多平台支持。
repos.summary_en: x-ui-yg is a streamlined modified script for setting up proxy servers. It supports advanced protocols like Hysteria2 and Xhttp, with various encryption methods. Integrated with Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN for traffic splitting, it outputs multiple subscription formats. Ideal for quickly deploying high-performance proxy services, with key features including local node generation and multi-platform support.

repos.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。
repos.summary_zh: 自动抓取合并全网公开代理节点，生成安全的 Clash Meta 订阅。集成智能分流、恶意网站拦截与多 CDN 镜像，提供高效安全的网络访问方案，并附带严谨的隐私与劳动合规声明。
repos.summary_en: Automatically fetches and merges public proxy nodes to generate secure Clash Meta subscriptions. Features smart routing, malicious site blocking, multi-CDN mirrors, and strong compliance stances for safe and efficient internet access.

repos.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新
repos.summary_zh: FreeNodes 是一个 AI 驱动的爬虫工具，专用于自动抓取 v2ray 和 Clash 的免费节点。它每日自动运行，从多个网站收集节点并生成 txt 和 yaml 格式的订阅列表，适用于学习交流。技术亮点包括 AI 集成和自动化更新机制，提升节点获取效率。
repos.summary_en: FreeNodes is an AI-powered crawler tool designed to automatically scrape free nodes for v2ray and Clash. It runs daily to collect nodes from multiple sources and generate subscription lists in txt and yaml formats, intended for educational use. Key features include AI integration and automated updates for efficient node acquisition.

repos.description: Open-Box 一体化透明代理：OpenWrt / Debian / Ubuntu / Docker；自有程序闭源，第三方组件遵守原许可。
repos.summary_zh: Open-Box 是一体化透明代理，支持 OpenWrt/Debian/Ubuntu/Docker 路由器端及多平台客户端。图形化面板无需配置文件即可管理订阅、分流与防火墙，集成 sing-box 内核与完整 Geo 数据，实现规则调试、链式代理与 DNS 直连，适用于局域网科学上网与流量优化。
repos.summary_en: Open-Box is an all-in-one transparent proxy solution with router support for OpenWrt, Debian, Ubuntu, Docker, and clients for Android, macOS, Windows, Linux. Its graphical panel enables management of subscriptions, traffic splitting, and firewalls without configuration files, integrating the sing-box kernel and full Geo data, featuring rule debugging, chain proxy, and direct DNS, suitable for scientific browsing and traffic optimization on LAN devices.

repos.description: 用于在 Heroku 上部署 V2Ray WebSocket。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现在Heroku平台一键部署V2Ray WebSocket服务，自动保持最新版本，资源占用合理以避免封号。通过自定义ID和路径增强安全性，并可集成CloudFlare提升性能，适用于快速搭建稳定代理服务的场景。
repos.summary_en: This project enables one-click deployment of V2Ray WebSocket on Heroku, automatically maintaining the latest version with reasonable resource usage to avoid account suspension. It enhances security via custom ID and path, and integrates with CloudFlare for performance improvement, suitable for quickly setting up stable proxy services.

repos.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。
repos.summary_zh: GOODBYEADS是一个强力去广告规则集合，专为AdGuard、Quantumult X和SmartDNS设计。它合并多个优质上游规则并去重整理，提供海量拦截规则、DNS拦截规则及白名单，支持多种格式下载，并定时更新，有效提升广告拦截效果与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: GOODBYEADS is a powerful ad-blocking rule collection designed for AdGuard, Quantumult X, and SmartDNS. It merges high-quality upstream rules, deduplicates and organizes them, providing massive blocking rules, DNS blocking rules, and whitelists. With multi-format support and regular updates, it enhances ad-blocking effectiveness and privacy protection.

repos.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️
repos.summary_zh: x-ui-pro 是一款集成 Nginx、Xray、Warp、Tor 的多协议抗审查代理面板自动安装脚本。支持 vless、trojan 等协议及 WebSocket/GRPC，具备多用户多域名部署、自动 SSL 续期、随机伪装页面等功能，适用于突破网络限制与安全代理场景。
repos.summary_en: x-ui-pro is an open-source auto-installation script designed to deploy a lightweight, highly secure multi-protocol web proxy panel. Integrating Nginx, Xray, Warp, Tor, and Psiphon, it supports advanced protocols like VLESS and Trojan over WebSocket, GRPC, and XHTTP. Optimized for bypassing censorship, it offers multi-domain management, auto SSL renewal, and low detection signatures.

repos.description: VLESS+XHTTP+TLS Auto-Installer for Ubuntu — Vercel / Netlify relay
repos.summary_zh: 一键在Ubuntu部署VLESS+XHTTP+TLS代理，通过Vercel/Netlify CDN中继流量，有效隐藏服务器真实IP以防封锁。支持自动SSL签发与智能修复，快速构建安全、高速、难被过滤的匿名代理通道。
repos.summary_en: Automates VLESS+XHTTP+TLS proxy setup on Ubuntu, masking the server IP via Vercel/Netlify CDN relay. Provides one-click deployment, auto SSL, and smart repair for secure, high-speed, anti-blocking access.

repos.description: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。
repos.summary_zh: Deadpool是一款基于Go语言的代理池工具，专为网络安全测试设计。它能从Hunter、Quake、Fofa等网络空间测绘平台自动获取高质量SOCKS5代理，或从本地文件导入代理，通过健康检查与去重机制构建稳定代理池。工具提供本地SOCKS5监听端口，支持流量转发与IP轮换，有效解决渗透测试中IP封禁问题。具备统计信息展示、优雅关闭、周期性任务及账号认证等特性，提升代理管理效率与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Deadpool is a Go-based proxy pool tool designed for cybersecurity testing. It automatically harvests high-quality SOCKS5 proxies from cyber space platforms like Hunter, Quake, and Fofa, or imports them locally. With health checks and deduplication, it maintains a reliable proxy pool and offers a local SOCKS5 listener for traffic forwarding and IP rotation, mitigating IP bans during penetration testing. Features include statistics display, graceful shutdown, periodic tasks, and authentication, enhancing proxy management efficiency and security.

repos.description: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于Protractor的代理爬虫工具，自动爬取代理信息并每3小时更新。支持TXT、JSON、CSV等多种格式下载，并按SOCKS5、SOCKS4、HTTP类型分类。适用于网络爬虫和匿名访问场景，技术亮点包括浏览器自动化、定期更新及代理测试功能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a proxy scraper built with Protractor that automatically crawls proxy information and updates every 3 hours. It supports downloading proxy lists in multiple formats (TXT, JSON, CSV, etc.) and categorizes by type (SOCKS5, SOCKS4, HTTP). Suitable for web scraping and anonymous browsing, key features include browser automation, regular updates, and proxy testing.

repos.description: 基于 mihomo 和 sing-box 的简单、稳定、开箱即用的 LuCI 代理应用
repos.summary_zh: Clashoo是面向OpenWrt的轻量级代理管理插件，集成mihomo和sing-box双内核，提供开箱即用的简洁体验。它通过统一LuCI界面实现配置管理、透明代理、DNS策略等高级功能，无需复杂命令行操作，适合家庭路由器和企业网关场景，兼顾稳定性与易用性。
repos.summary_en: Clashoo is a lightweight proxy management plugin for OpenWrt, integrating mihomo and sing-box dual kernels to provide an out-of-the-box simple experience. It offers a unified LuCI interface for configuration management, transparent proxy, and DNS policies, eliminating complex command-line operations. Suitable for home routers and enterprise gateways, it balances stability and ease of use.

repos.description: 免费节点订阅：Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket｜Base64 与 YAML 每 2 小时更新
repos.summary_zh: 提供每两小时更新的免费节点订阅，支持Base64与Clash YAML格式。适用于Clash、V2RayN及Shadowrocket，自动解析公开节点并按地理归属统一命名，是便捷的代理节点聚合与格式转换工具。
repos.summary_en: Provides free proxy node subscriptions updated every two hours, supporting both Base64 and Clash YAML formats for seamless integration. Compatible with Clash, V2RayN, and Shadowrocket, it automatically parses, validates, and formats public nodes with unified geographic naming, serving as an essential multi-client proxy aggregator and format conversion tool.

repos.summary_zh: 一款功能完善的推特媒体批量下载器，支持多博主管理、智能去重、日期范围过滤及代理配置，旨在实现高效、自动化的社交媒体资源抓取与备份。
repos.summary_en: An efficient Twitter media downloader designed for batch downloading images and videos from multiple bloggers. It features smart deduplication, customizable date filters, proxy support, and flexible path configuration, ensuring automated and reliable social media resource archiving.
